plain: In dark mode the subtle, floating and overlay shadows are now three times as opaque, so raised surfaces read; set --primitive-shadow-strength yourself to tune it.

steps.plain: --semantic-shadow-floating now multiplies its opacity by --primitive-shadow-strength (3 in dark mode), so it is darker on dark surfaces; if you override it, keep the calc() or set the strength.
--semantic-shadow-overlay now multiplies its opacity by --primitive-shadow-strength (3 in dark mode), so it is darker on dark surfaces; if you override it, keep the calc() or set the strength.
--semantic-shadow-subtle now multiplies its opacity by --primitive-shadow-strength (3 in dark mode), so it is darker on dark surfaces; if you override it, keep the calc() or set the strength.
